name: Norske festninger (Norwegian fortresses)
title: Norske festninger (Norwegian fortresses)
description: Norwegian fortresses (festninger), defensive military installations spanning medieval royal castles (Akershus, Bergenhus, Vardøhus, Tunsberghus, Steinvikholm), 17th-century Danish-Norwegian frontier fortresses (Fredriksten in Halden, Kongsvinger, Christiansten in Trondheim, Christiansand, Christiansø, Fredriksholm), 20th-century coastal defense systems (Oscarsborg famed for sinking Blücher 1940, Hegra, Narvik, Oslofjord, Agdenes complex), and minor forts/signal stations. Sourced from no.wikipedia category Festninger i Norge plus subcats (Festninger i Østfold, Agdenes festning). Enriched with Wikidata wbgetentities for multilingual names/descriptions (34 langs), properties (country, types, admin location, location, part of, materials, heritage status, architectural styles, operators, etc.), coordinates, inception date, image URLs, and Wikipedia sitelinks across 34 language editions.
